---
title: "FILTER_RGREAT_GOTERMS"
format: html
editor: visual
---


```{r}
# READ RGREAT RESULTS - POSITIVE WEIGHTS
rgreat_f1_bulk_pos <- read.csv(file.path(mofa_out_dir, 
                        "rgreat_results/rGREAT_opalin_factor1_bulk_positive.csv"))

# APPLY FILTER
rgreat_f1_bulk_pos_filtered <- rgreat_f1_bulk_pos %>%
  filter(p_adjust < 0.05,
         fold_enrichment > 2,
         observed_region_hits >= 10) %>%
  arrange(p_adjust, desc(fold_enrichment))

# CHECK HOW MANY TERMS REMAIN
cat("Terms before filtering:", nrow(rgreat_f1_bulk_pos), "\n")
cat("Terms after filtering:", nrow(rgreat_f1_bulk_pos_filtered), "\n")

# VIEW TOP TERMS
head(rgreat_f1_bulk_pos_filtered[, c("id", "description", 
                                      "fold_enrichment", 
                                      "observed_region_hits", 
                                      "p_adjust")], 20)

# EXPORT FOR REVIGO
revigo_input_pos <- rgreat_f1_bulk_pos_filtered[, c("id", "p_adjust")]
write.csv(revigo_input_pos,
          file.path(revigo_dir, "revigo_input_opalin_f1_bulk_pos.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("Saved REVIGO input to:", file.path(revigo_dir, "revigo_input_opalin_f1_bulk_pos.csv"), "\n")
```
